name: Prantor Pay
author: Prantorpay

sections.description:
Prantor Pay is a powerful WooCommerce payment gateway plugin that allows your customers to pay with popular Bangladesh payment methods including Bkash, Nagad, Rocket, and all major BD gateways.

With Prantor Pay, you can:
– Accept payments from all major Bangladesh payment methods
– Automate your payment processing
– Get real-time payment confirmations
– Secure transaction handling with webhook verification
– Easy integration with WooCommerce

Features

  • Support for Bkash, Nagad, Rocket, and all BD gateways
  • Real-time payment verification
  • Webhook integration for automatic order updates
  • Digital and physical product support
  • USD to BDT currency conversion
  • Secure payment processing
  • Easy setup and configuration

Configuration

  1. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  2. Click on “Prantor Pay” to configure
  3. Enable the payment method
  4. Enter your API Key from your Prantor Pay account
  5. Set the USD conversion rate (if needed)
  6. Choose whether to enable digital products
  7. The payment site URL will be pre-filled

How It Works

  1. Customer proceeds to checkout and selects Prantor Pay
  2. Customer is redirected to Prantor Pay payment page
  3. Customer completes payment through their preferred method
  4. Prantor Pay confirms payment and redirects back to your store
  5. Order status is automatically updated

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.2 or higher
  • WooCommerce plugin installed and activated
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • SSL Certificate (HTTPS)
  • Valid Prantor Pay merchant account

Getting Started

  1. Create a merchant account at https://prantorpay.com/
  2. Get your API key from your merchant dashboard
  3. Install and activate the plugin
  4. Configure with your API key
  5. Start accepting payments!

Support

For support, visit:
– Website: https://prantorpay.com/
– Email: support@prantorpay.com
– Documentation: https://prantorpay.com/docs

Additional Information

Prantor Pay Features

  • Real-time payment processing
  • Instant payment verification
  • Secure API integration
  • Webhook support
  • Multi-currency support
  • 24/7 support

Integration Details

The plugin integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce and handles:
– Order creation and management
– Payment verification
– Automatic order status updates
– Customer notification
– Transaction logging

If you encounter any issues, please contact support@prantorpay.com or visit https://prantorpay.com/

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later. See LICENSE file for details.

Credits

Prantor Payment Team
https://prantorpay.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  4. Enable Prantor Pay and configure your API key
  5. Set your payment site URL (typically https://securepay.prantorpay.com/)
  6. Save changes
sections.faq:
Do I need a Prantor Pay merchant account?

Yes, you need a valid merchant account to use this plugin.

What payment methods does Prantor Pay support?

Prantor Pay supports Bkash, Nagad, Rocket, and all major Bangladesh payment gateways.

What currencies does the plugin support?

The plugin supports BDT and USD with configurable conversion rates.

Is it secure?

Yes, all transactions are processed securely through Prantor Pay’s API with SSL encryption required.

Can I test the plugin before going live?

Yes, Prantor Pay provides a sandbox environment for testing.

What happens if a payment fails?

The order status will remain as pending and the customer can retry payment.
